detail.longDescription: PHP2Shell: patch now. Patching takes days, attacks took hours. How bifrost security covers the gap: → Our CVE prioritisation engine shows every running instance of vulnerable PHP in your clusters → Enforced runtime profiles block shells, tool downloads, dropped binaries and credential theft → Every blocked attempt is a high-confidence alert Hardened before the patch. The deep dive, with what to look for while you patch: https:// bifrostsec.com/blog/2026/php2s hell-security-advisory/ # PHP2Shell # Kubernetes # infosec # RuntimeSecurity
